name: IPALT
summary: iPALT, or ALiPT, also known as N-isopropyl-N-allyltryptamine or by its developmental code name ASR-3003, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family. It is an asymmetrical analogue of diisopropyltryptamine (DiPT) and diallyltryptamine (DALT).

pharmacology.text: The drug is a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT1B, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT6 receptors, but not of the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor. It is also a serotonin reuptake inhibitor, but does not inhibit dopamine or norepinephrine reuptake.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: 5-MeO-iPALT is known to be a psychedelic drug in humans and is under development for potential medical use. iPALT was patented by the Alexander Shulgin Research Institute (ASRI) in 2024.
